g.text: B3 | Native velocity and pressure compared at identical physical positions
New field: refined accepted steady solution. Strict P1 interpolation is an analysis operation, with no extrapolation.
White regions are outside that model’s fluid domain; red points belong to the original clot. Pressure is outlet-referenced gauge pressure.
